Subject: Procurement readiness & next steps — AcmeCloud pilot

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for a productive call today — great to hear more about the AcmeCloud pilot use case and the success criteria you outlined. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align with your procurement cadence: 

Recap (tailored to what we discussed):
- Pilot scope: 3 internal teams, ~250k tokens/month, staging + prod access.
- Security: you requested SOC 2 report and our security questionnaire answers.
- Legal/commercial: you prefer to pursue a PO for production but may use card for an initial short trial.
- Marketplace: you asked whether Redwood can be contracted via AWS Marketplace (we can — optional).

Procurement path questions / asks for your team:
1) Preferred commercial path: PO (standard) vs corporate card for pilot vs marketplace contract? Please confirm which path you prefer so we can tailor the mutual action plan (MAP).
2) Key reviewers and owners for each milestone (legal, security, finance) — please confirm names & roles.
3) Target PO issuance date / target go-live window.

Proposed mutual action plan (suggested milestones & owners):
- 6/18: Redwood sends draft MPA + PO template + security pack (attached: Acme_MPA_v1.xlsx) — Owner: Marissa (Redwood)
- 6/22: Acme legal review kickoff (internal) — Owner: Acme Legal (TBD)
- 6/26: Security questionnaire & SOC2 review complete — Owner: Acme Security / Redwood (Camila providing answers)
- 7/02: Finance sign-off / PO requested — Owner: Acme Finance (Tom)
- 7/10: PO issuance & signatures / invoicing to begin — Owner: Acme Finance / Redwood Billing

If that timeline looks reasonable, we can formalize the MAP and I can send a DocuSign for signatures once your legal confirms. Also looping in Camila (solutions engineering) to get a security checklist answered quickly.

Let me know the preferred commercial path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and who from your side will own legal / security / finance so we can update the timeline.

Thanks,

--

Thanks Marissa — helpful summary and timeline.

A few notes from our side after internal sync:
- Commercial path: our preference is to do a PO for the pilot and production; for an initial smoke test we may run a card to speed things up, but procurement strongly prefers PO for any ongoing usage.
- Review owners:
  - Legal: Maria Chen (Acme Legal) — will pick up review week of 6/22
  - Security: Raj Patel (Acme Security) — will run the questionnaire and SOC2 review in parallel (target complete by end of week 6/26)
  - Finance: Tom Riley — will handle PO issuance and invoicing; target PO issuance mid-July (we're aiming for ~7/10–7/15)

Action items for Redwood: please send your PO template and the security pack (SOC2 + questionnaire answers). Also send a short MPA that maps the milestones above so legal can see expected dates.

One note on marketplace: we are evaluating AWS Marketplace, but that'll add another procurement track and can slow things down; would prefer direct PO unless Redwood strongly recommends marketplace for billing simplicity.

I'll confirm Maria/Raj's emails if you need direct contacts for legal/security.

Appreciate it,
Alex

--
